research.topic: Highest capital city: La Paz, Bolivia, seat of government at about 3,640 m (city spans roughly 3,200–4,100 m); Sucre is the constitutional capital at about 2,800 m. Quito about 2,850 m; Kathmandu about 1,400 m. El Alto International Airport, above La Paz, is at 4,061 m, among the highest international airports. At 3,600 m the partial pressure of oxygen is roughly 65 % of sea level. Bolivia's national football team has a strong home record at the Estadio Hernando Siles (3,637 m); FIFA briefly tried to ban internationals above 2,500 m in 2007.

myths.myth: Quito is the highest capital in the world.
myths.reality: Quito, at about 2,850 m, is the highest constitutional capital; La Paz, Bolivia's seat of government, is higher at about 3,640 m — which is why most lists give La Paz.
